receipt.public_excerpt: Microsoft booked $24.1 billion in revenue from OpenAI during the year to June, Bloomberg reported. The company disclosed the figure in a filing last week. That is most of its AI business. By Bloomberg’s estimate, OpenAI is more than half of Microsoft’s actual AI sales, and probably around 70%.

evidence_items.explanation: For Microsoft, OpenAI alone is estimated at about 70% of FY2026 AI revenue. Adding Anthropic would only raise that, so the concentration part holds for Microsoft.

receipt.public_excerpt: It is the clearest picture yet, and the first time Microsoft has spelled the figure out. Investors have pressed the company on exactly this.

evidence_items.explanation: The UBS figures measure the labs' share of total Google Cloud revenue, not AI revenue. They neither confirm nor refute his inferred 70%+ share of Google's AI revenue.
